_readme: Tuning knobs for the Organic Brief (scripts/build_brief.py). Edit and re-run; no code changes needed. Keys starting with _ are comments.

output._readme: Brief is written next to the Detail Pack (index.html) at the repo root as <prefix><YYYY-MM-DD>.html, date = the data file's week-end date.

_neutral_readme: Week-over-week drops up to this % show a blue (neutral) ▼ instead of red.

scoreboard._readme: Engagement rate = interactions / denominator. 'impressions' uses views_by_channel (always available); 'reach' uses the sum of social_posts[].reach per platform (only if the run wrote social_posts).

social_wins._readme: Top posts of the week from social_posts. Candidates = posts from the top_properties properties ranked by property_rank_metric (0 = all). rate = sort_metric / denominator_metric; posts under min_denominator are skipped. Always top_n; up to max_n only if the extra post's rate is at least extra_if_rate_at_least_ratio_of_last x the last included post's rate.

gmb_top_properties._readme: Ranking score = sum(weight * metric) over gbp_by_property. Cards show Reach (search+maps) and Clicks (website+phone+directions) with their top source; a 2nd source is shown when within even_within_pct of the top one.

url_tracking._readme: Slides 5-6 (Organic URL Tracking). Labels are the Detail Pack's GA4 names: Views, Sessions, Engaged sessions, Key events -- never 'leads' or 'clicks'. Reads the GA4 organic_links block (one entry per source); older files fall back to the Detail Pack's url_tracking / gmb_url_tracking. bar_field = the metric drawn as bars on slide 6; key events are the pills.

top_channels._readme: Slide 1 header. Each entry = [label, *_by_channel key, field (current|delta), scope (all = incl. Google Business | social)]. Equal values show as 'Even'.

_top_brands_readme: Social Scoreboard reach & engagement slide: top N brands by Views (properties[].views, top channel from views_channels) and by Engagement (properties[].engagement + that property's GMB clicks when brand_engagement_includes_gmb; top channel from properties[].engagement_channels).
